name: go-spec-reviewer
title_zh: 开工前先让子代理挑刺的 Go 设计稿终审
tagline_zh: 写代码前先花两分钟过一遍设计稿：完整性、一致性、Go 惯例、Cobra/Viper 规范，子代理逐条挑刺，省得返工。
tagline_en: Before you code, a subagent audits your Go spec for completeness, consistency, idiomatic Go, and Cobra/Viper.
desc_en: Review a Go design spec before implementation begins - dispatch a subagent that checks a design doc for completeness, consistency, and idiomatic Go (simplicity, small consumer-defined interfaces, explicit wrapped errors, context propagation) plus Cobra/Viper conventions where applicable. Use when a user has a Go spec to review, asks "is this spec ready?", or is about to implement from a written de
why_zh: 把「设计评审」从口头约定变成可执行关卡。子代理按固定清单查，不靠人脑临时发挥。
why_en: Turns design review from a vague habit into a repeatable gate—subagent checks a fixed checklist, catching blind spots humans.
limit_zh: 只审 Go 设计文档，不审代码本身；需要 spec 是文字可读的（Markdown/文本），不认纯脑图或口头描述。
limit_en: Go specs only, not code; requires readable text (Markdown/plain), not mindmaps or verbal; checks Cobra/Viper conventions only—other frameworks.
